  roic_n_sector_stocks: 0
  roic_n_subsector_stocks: 0

  momentum_anomaly_data: NULL

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_ggplot_theme()
```

## Price Decomposition

```{r decomposition-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(params$decomposition_data) && nrow(params$decomposition_data) > 0) {
  plot_price_decomposition(
    data = params$decomposition_data,
    ticker = params$ticker,
    metric_name = params$decomposition_metric_display_name,
    base_date = params$decomposition_base_date,
    numerator = params$decomposition_numerator
  )
}
```

```{r share-count-decomposition-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(params$share_count_decomposition_data) && nrow(params$share_count_decomposition_data) > 0) {
  plot_share_count_decomposition(
    data = params$share_count_decomposition_data,
    ticker = params$ticker,
    metric_name = params$decomposition_metric_display_name,
    base_date = params$decomposition_base_date
  )
}
```

```{r kpi-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(params$decomposition_kpi_data) && nrow(params$decomposition_kpi_data) > 0) {
  plot_financial_kpi(
    data = params$decomposition_kpi_data,
    ticker = params$ticker,
    metric_name = paste0("TTM ", params$decomposition_metric_display_name, " (per share)"),
    fill_color = "#7A9DC7"
  )
}
```

## Cumulative Return

```{r return-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_cumulative_return(
  params$ticker_data,
  params$ticker,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$n_subsector_stocks
)
```

## Drawdown from Highs

```{r drawdown-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_drawdown(
  params$ticker_data,
  params$ticker,
  subsector_median_drawdown = params$subsector_median_drawdown,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$n_subsector_stocks
) %>%
  add_data_callout(label_fn = scales::percent)
```

## Valuation and ROIC

```{r valuation-roic-charts, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
p_valuation <- plot_valuation_ratio(
  params$valuation_data,
  params$ticker,
  metric_name = params$valuation_metric_name,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$valuation_n_subsector_stocks
)

p_roic <- plot_roic(
  params$roic_data,
  params$ticker,
  subsector_name = params$subsector_name,
  n_subsector_stocks = params$roic_n_subsector_stocks
)

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_valuation, p_roic, ncol = 2)
```

## DuPont Decomposition

```{r dupont-over-time, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(params$dupont_over_time_data) && nrow(params$dupont_over_time_data) > 0) {
  # Use ROIC if: mode is "roic", P/B is NULL, or P/B > 10x
  use_roic <- params$dupont_mode != "roe" ||
              is.null(params$price_to_book) ||
              params$price_to_book > 10

  if (use_roic) {
    plot_dupont_over_time(
      data = params$dupont_over_time_data,
      ticker = params$ticker,
      return_label = "ROIC",
      effect_label = "Capital Efficiency Effect",
      numerator_name = params$dupont_numerator_name,
      denominator_name = "Invested Capital",
      multiplier_label = "Assets / IC",
      title_suffix = "ROIC Decomposition"
    )
  } else {
    plot_dupont_over_time(
      data = params$dupont_over_time_data,
      ticker = params$ticker,
      return_label = "ROE",
      effect_label = "Financial Leverage Effect",
      numerator_name = params$dupont_numerator_name,
      denominator_name = "Equity",
      multiplier_label = "Equity Multiplier",
      title_suffix = "ROE Decomposition (DuPont)"
    )
  }
}
```

## Momentum Divergence

```{r anomaly-momentum, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
envelope_momentum <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$momentum_anomaly_data$ttm_return,
  params$momentum_anomaly_data$return_3m,
  contamination = 0.1,
  winsorize_pct = 0.02
)

plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$momentum_anomaly_data,
  x_col = "ttm_return",
  y_col = "return_3m",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  focus_group_col = "subsector",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_focus_group = params$subsector_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_momentum,
  x_label = "TTM Return (%)",
  y_label = "3-Month Return (%)",
  x_pct_labels = TRUE,
  y_pct_labels = TRUE,
  n_population = params$n_sector_stocks,
  n_focus_group = params$n_subsector_stocks,
  population_label = params$sector_name,
  focus_group_label = params$subsector_name
)
```

## Operating Margin vs Asset Turnover

```{r anomaly-dupont, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
envelope_dupont <- fit_elliptic_envelope(
  params$dupont_anomaly_data$operating_margin,
  params$dupont_anomaly_data$asset_turnover,
  contamination = 0.1,
  winsorize_pct = 0.02
)

plot_elliptic_envelope(
  data = params$dupont_anomaly_data,
  x_col = "operating_margin",
  y_col = "asset_turnover",
  ticker_col = "ticker",
  focus_group_col = "industry",
  target_ticker = params$ticker,
  target_focus_group = params$industry_name,
  envelope_fit = envelope_dupont,
  x_label = "Operating Margin (%)",
  y_label = "Asset Turnover (x)",
  subtitle = "Excludes stocks with negative operating income",
  x_pct_labels = TRUE,
  n_population = params$n_subsector_stocks,
  n_focus_group = params$n_industry_stocks,
  population_label = params$subsector_name,
  focus_group_label = params$industry_name
)
```
